messages:
Harper: Poking the group: prototype for an automated quant "auto-tuner" that adjusts per-tenant quant profiles (FP8/INT8/4-bit) based on rolling quality-cost tradeoff. Need ops + CI hooks before we try in canary.
Dmitri: Interesting. What signals drive the tuner?
Harper: Short list: live deg_score delta, embedding drift (L2), p95 latency delta, and realized cost-per-token. We compute a rolling regret = max(0, quality_penalty_weight*deg_delta - cost_savings_weight*cost_delta). If regret > threshold for window -> reduce precision (e.g., FP8->INT8) or route tenant off the new path.
Yuki: Who owns the weights/thresholds? Per-tenant defaults or global?
Harper: Config stack: global defaults, tenant overrides (customer can opt out), and model-specific minima. We'll expose thresholds in model manifest canary block so CI can lint for presence.
Dmitri: Safety rules? We can't let tuner oscillate or auto-escalate customers silently.
Harper: Safety checklist: 1) min_watch_window = 45m or 2k reqs. 2) bootstrap 95% CI on deg_score required before action. 3) hysteresis: once a tenant is switched off a low-precision path, block rejoin for 24h unless manual override. 4) Tiered fallback order: tenant_override -> INT8 -> float32. 5) any automatic switch generates an incident entry and notifies model owner + tenant owner.
Yuki: Telemetry/trace tags?
Harper: Tag every request: X-Quant-Profile, X-Quant-Flags, X-Tuner-Decision (none|deferred|switched). Traces: trace.quant.profile, trace.tuner.regret, trace.tuner.decisions. Structured log example:
{"ts":"...","req_id":"r-900","tenant":"beta","quant_profile":"fp8-fast","deg_score":0.017,"regret":0.004,"tuner_decision":"deferred"}
Dmitri: CI/PR requirements?
Harper: Any change to a quant profile must include: a) canary YAML with tuner_policy block, b) synthetic playback report (per-bucket), c) cost-savings estimate, d) runbook snippet. Lint fails PR if missing. We'll add a manifest linter.
Yuki: How do we validate tuner code? Can we shadow-run the tuner logic for a week before letting it act?
Harper: Yes — deployment plan: shadow-mode for 7d (tuner emits decisions but platform ignores them), then canary for 0.5% tenants for 48h, then gradual expansion. Shadow logs collected into tuner-sim bucket for offline audit.
ops-bot: tuner-sim started: model=redwood-mosaic-auto-tune run=shadow-2026-03 sample=0.5%
Dmitri: One more: per-token mixing? Does the tuner permit tokenwise switching?
Harper: Not yet. Tuner acts at per-request granularity for now. Per-token mixing is an experimental feature behind an infra flag and requires separate approval.
Yuki: Sounds good. Please draft the YAML schema for tuner_policy and the linter rule. I can help with the shadow collection pipeline.
Harper: Will do. Opening PRs for: tuner_playbook, manifest-lint, shadow-pipeline. Thanks.
